snippet.title: Low_Signal Announcement Trailer US
snippet.description:
Low Signal is a first-person narrative walking sim structured like a metroidvania.
Helped by various abilities, explore an abandonned 90's asian slum, gather documents along with objects to uncover what happened to its last inhabitants and interact with a strange Altar to unveil the whole story.
